root_moisture_decreasing.headline: Root-Zone Drying Trend Detected
root_moisture_decreasing.message: Independent satellite and reanalysis observations indicate a statistically significant decline in root-zone soil wetness. Transition towards deep-rooting, drought-resilient crops and water-conserving practices.
practices: Shift from flood irrigation to drip or sprinkler micro-irrigation systems.
Adopt conservation furrow and broad-bed furrow planting for moisture conservation.
Maintain 30%+ crop residue mulch on soil surface.
Construct farm ponds for critical stage supplemental protective irrigation.

root_moisture_increasing.headline: Root-Zone Moisture Expansion Trend Detected
root_moisture_increasing.message: Significant upward trend in root-zone wetness observed. Take advantage of improved moisture availability while safeguarding against root asphyxiation.
practices: Construct perimeter drainage trenches and raised beds to prevent waterlogging.
Introduce green manures and high-biomass cover crops.
Select waterlogging-tolerant varieties.

surface_moisture_decreasing.headline: Topsoil Desiccation Trend Detected
surface_moisture_decreasing.message: Topsoil (0-10 cm) moisture is exhibiting a downward trend, heightening early seed germination risk.
practices: Apply light pre-sowing irrigation or time drilling precisely with rain events.
Use organic or plastic mulch to suppress surface evaporation.
Adopt zero-till seed drills to preserve residual seedbed moisture.

surface_moisture_increasing.headline: Surface Wetness Increase Trend Detected
surface_moisture_increasing.message: Surface moisture is trending higher, which facilitates seedling establishment but increases fungal damping-off risks.
practices: Treat seeds with bio-fungicides (Trichoderma viride) prior to sowing.
Ensure surface drainage to avoid crusting and seed rot.

air_temperature_increasing.headline: Warming Trend & Thermal Stress Risk Detected
air_temperature_increasing.message: Significant warming detected over the multi-decadal observation period. Elevated temperatures accelerate phenology and reduce grain-filling duration.
practices: Advance rabi sowing window to complete grain filling before March heat spikes.
Adopt heat-tolerant cultivars (e.g. DBW series for wheat, heat-tolerant pulses).
Employ micro-sprinklers for microclimate evaporative cooling during bloom.
Maintain organic ground cover to moderate root-zone temperature.

air_temperature_decreasing.headline: Cooling / Lower Thermal Window Trend Detected
air_temperature_decreasing.message: Thermal accumulation trend shows moderation. Cold-sensitive crops may experience extended maturity windows.
practices: Avoid late sowing to ensure adequate growing degree days before peak winter.
Provide light smoke or protective irrigation during cold wave / frost alerts.

rainfall_decreasing.headline: Precipitation Deficit Trend Detected
rainfall_decreasing.message: Significant reduction in annual rainfall totals observed across satellite precipitation datasets. Adapt crop selection to lower rainfall regimes.
practices: Adopt dryland farming packages and drought-hardy millets.
Harvest runoff in in-situ farm ponds for 1-2 life-saving supplemental irrigations.
Practice wider row spacing and population thinning to reduce moisture competition.

rainfall_increasing.headline: Precipitation Enhancement Trend Detected
rainfall_increasing.message: Annual rainfall volume has increased over the multi-decadal baseline, offering higher water harvesting and crop production potential.
practices: Invest in drainage infrastructure to prevent ponding and nutrient leaching.
Harvest excess runoff into community tanks or recharge open wells.
Introduce double-cropping where rainfall season duration has extended.

evapotranspiration_increasing.headline: Atmospheric Evaporative Demand Trending Upward
evapotranspiration_increasing.message: Higher crop water requirements driven by elevated vapor pressure deficits and temperatures.
practices: Install windbreaks and shelterbelts along farm borders to reduce advective drying.
Switch to precision drip fertigation to match peak evaporative demand.

evapotranspiration_decreasing.headline: Evaporative Demand Trending Downward
evapotranspiration_decreasing.message: Lower reference evapotranspiration observed, often linked to increased cloudiness or aerosol dimming.
practices: Monitor fungal foliar diseases associated with prolonged leaf wetness and humidity.

ndvi_decreasing.headline: Vegetation Productivity Decline Detected
ndvi_decreasing.message: MODIS satellite vegetation index reveals multi-year decline in vegetative vigor and green biomass across this grid cell.
practices: Conduct comprehensive soil fertility testing to identify micronutrient and organic matter deficits.
Survey local stands for chronic pest infestation, soil salinity, or groundwater depletion.

evi_decreasing.headline: Enhanced Vegetation Index Downward Trend Detected
evi_decreasing.message: Multi-year decrease in canopy structural vigor detected via MODIS EVI time series.
practices: Implement integrated soil health and restorative crop rotations.

no2_increasing.headline: Elevated Tropospheric NO2 Trend (Air Quality Context)
no2_increasing.message: Satellite OMI sensor records increased tropospheric NO2 column density. This provides regional industrial / transport emissions context only and does NOT warrant a crop change.
practices: Air quality context only. Maintain standard agronomic practices.

ozone_increasing.headline: Elevated Total Column Ozone Trend (Air Quality Context)
ozone_increasing.message: Satellite OMI sensor records increased total column ozone. This provides atmospheric context only and does NOT warrant a crop change.
practices: Air quality context only. Maintain standard agronomic practices.
